description: Aggregated monitor view: config + current state + recent triggered events + active downtimes in one call. Replaces 3 round-trips of get-monitor + get-events + list-downtimes.

extractFields.description: Comma-separated dotted paths to project from response (e.g. 'id,name,owner.name,columns.*.name'). Use `*` as wildcard for arrays/objects. Wrap field names with dots in backticks. Reduces response tokens dramatically on large entities.

hoursBack.description: Hours to look back for triggered events (default 24)

includeDowntimes.description: Include active downtimes for this monitor (default true)

name: analyze-monitor-state
